charts.section: Which storm exposes the guardrail problem?
charts.report_copy: Across all 699 exact alternatives, the four synthetic storms do not reveal the same behavior. The long-duration event exposes 420 peak increases, while the deeper stress event exposes 47. Rainfall depth alone does not identify the controlling modeled response.
charts.caption: Exact synthetic fixture result. A real project must supply authoritative storms and a declared precision and tolerance policy.

charts.section: What can a teaching subset miss?
charts.report_copy: The deterministic guided replay covers 220 of 699 alternatives, two of twelve rule-feasible designs, 127 of 421 adverse designs, and none of the four exact feasible-frontier alternatives. It demonstrates the workflow; it does not establish an exhaustive winner.
charts.caption: Coverage audit of the guided subset against the complete Cedar Trace exact oracle.

charts.section: What does the complete design landscape look like?
charts.report_copy: All 699 nonbaseline combinations are shown against cost and aggregate volume reduction, with adverse peak behavior and the complete-rule shortlist restored. Twelve alternatives satisfy the teaching contract; four are nondominated within that feasible set.
charts.caption: Nondominated means only that no exact feasible alternative is both cheaper and better on aggregate volume in this bounded synthetic universe.

charts.section: Why is the complete decision contract necessary?
charts.report_copy: Forty-six alternatives satisfy cost and aggregate volume together, but 34 of those increase at least one selected-storm peak. Checking only the two visible axes would leave a shortlist nearly four times too large.
charts.caption: All 699 alternatives passed the fixture's numerical execution checks; the reduction from 46 to 12 comes from the peak guardrail.

charts.section: Does adaptive search use the exact-run budget better?
charts.report_copy: Ten seeds compare Random, scrambled Sobol, deterministic integer NSGA-II, and Sobol plus ExtraTrees at 256, 512, and 1,024 exact-job equivalents. ExtraTrees becomes strong at the largest budget, but its middle-budget lower tail is unstable.
charts.caption: Median with 10th–90th percentile bands. Replays reveal outcomes from the frozen exact oracle only after a design request; no predicted hydraulic value appears in the result.

charts.report_copy: No. The adaptive method beats Sobol strongly at the largest budget, but not at two budgets, and its lower-tail condition fails. The study also covers only one synthetic network. The preregistered 95% adverse-recall gate is mathematically unreachable with 256 requests against 421 adverse alternatives, so that gate must be redesigned before a multi-network release study.
charts.caption: Production remains on scrambled Sobol. Adaptive ML stays experimental; the benchmark reports both encouraging and disqualifying evidence.
